_doc: Head-phantom geometry for the API (Proton Activity) source mode: the Air world and the CRYSP ring (scanner axis along the beam, +z). The phantom section is a PLACEHOLDER — in mode="api" the driver replaces it with the phantom built from the scenario's phantom_regions.csv (the single source of truth), so its dimensions/material here are not used. Dimensions in cm; material keys into data/materials.json.
